The environment is comfortable and elegant, and the soy sauce crab is very delicious. I have tasted it twice during this trip to Busan and it is worth recommending

rv.t: As a tteokbokki lover, Leegane was my number one priority when visiting Busan. This legendary stall has been featured on numerous Korean TV shows over the years, which only made me want to try it even more. There was a queue when I arrived, but it moved fairly quickly! What makes Leegane special is their rich tteokbokki that is double stewed with radish juice, giving the sauce a uniquely deep and fragrant flavor…

Stumbled upon this stall while roaming around the markets. The tteokbokki was delicious, not too sweet or too spicy. The rice cakes were well made, soft with a nice chewiness. The fish cake was also delicious. We ended up adding an order of fried food because it looked good and we knew the sauce would go well with it. Only later did we realise you could order a tteokbokki and fried set, instead of getting them…
It’s super tasty and there’s a standing area with airconditioning.

I tried Mulhwae/Mulhoe for the first time. The rockfish is a bit crisp and chewy. The cold soup with is refreshing on a hot day. I also tried the hagfish. I didnt know how to eat it but then learned to wrap it in the lettuce…

So yummy!! We got the mulhoe and beef hotpot, and their service is so sweet. I got help with my mulhoe and a little lesson on how people in Busan like to eat it :) Also, very friendly and accommodating for any foreigners -- especially Muslims or non-pork eaters. All food is beef or seafood!

Super yummy seafood stew at this place! Spicy isn’t too spicy. I loved how fresh everything was, even the mussels which I don’t usually eat. Add on a Kalguksu for the perfect carby ending. The whole portion is just nice for two people.

One thing: didn't blow me away with rich flavours in the porridge. Service was smooth, plus the self-ordering machine on the table was a neat touch. Overall, nice dining experience. Would come back to try other dishes.
We came almost 8pm and made last-minute order (last order is 8pm). Abalone porridge and grilled sea bream were so tasty. Variety of banchan go so well with Abalone porridge.
very authentic JEJU ABALONE PORRIDGE side dishes are high quality (unlimited refill) Reasonable price and good as breakfast option

However, you can't deny the quality, value and freshness of the abalones! Personally the green porridge wasn't for me but their steamed abalone was AMAZING! Make sure to dip it in the sesame oil that's provided, but mix that with salt and pepper and…

Widely considered one of the best spots in Mipo for authentic abalone porridge. The dish is incredibly rich and nutty, packed with fresh, chunky pieces of abalone. Its deep green color proves the use of high-quality innards, offering a nourishing and deeply flavorful coastal dining experience.

Very touristy. I think everyone in the store were tourists in fact haha. They have a rule that you must order one dish per person. So my boyfriend sat outside as I ate my TikTok famous abalone porridge by myself. At first it was a bit bland, but then I added salt and their banchan chives and it was pretty good! I took away the rest for my boyfriend to eat on the park bench lol.

Jagalchi Market is a must-visit if you're in Busan, especially if you love seafood. It's an enormous fish market with an incredible variety of fresh seafood, making it a fascinating place to explore. We had the opportunity to eat there and it was a fantastic experience. We ordered a fresh fish, which was prepared half as sashimi and half cooked, so we could enjoy it in two different ways. We also tried the octopus…

For seafood lovers, this place is an absolute must-visit. Head up to the second floor where you can enjoy freshly cooked seafood or try their famous marinated seafood dishes. There are two ways to enjoy your meal here you can either buy fresh seafood yourself from the street vendors or the seafood market on the first floor, then bring it upstairs to be cooked, or simply order directly from the restaurant on the…

Hospitable waiter. Good food but not the best pork rice soup I’ve had in Busan. Very affordable though.

Very light broth to let the quality of the pork shine. There are shrimp sauce(super salty), miso sauce, chili paste, black pepper, and salt for seasoning. Overall i found it quite nourishing without being heavy on the stomach.

rv.t: We visited Gamcheon Culture Village and it’s definitely colorful and great for photos, but just know what you’re getting into. If you don’t want a tedious walk uphill, take the bus up. Use Google Maps to find the stop — look for bus 1-1 or 2-2. There’s a lot of Korean characters and zodiac symbols in front of the numbers, but you can just ignore those and board 1-1 or 2-2 and you’ll be fine. The whole place is…

July 2026 This is such a unique place to visit. We took an Uber Taxi and he dropped us off right in front of the main entrance with the gate to enter the village. We arrived a little late in the early evening, so most businesses were already closed. But, we were able to hike up the main street and find lots of great views of the colorful town from up high. As you walk, you will see so many murals and statues of the…

Gamcheon Culture Village is one of Busan's most famous tourist attractions, known for its colorful hillside houses, narrow alleyways, and vibrant street art. Originally established as a residential community, it has been transformed into a cultural destination filled with murals, sculptures, galleries, cafés, and craft shops. Visitors can explore the winding streets, enjoy panoramic views of the city, and take…

I originally just wanted to collect the ribbon and sticker as a keepsake, but I ended up gaining so many beautiful memories. Every staff member I met was incredibly kind and polite—their warm smiles and patience made me feel truly cared for and deeply touched. Although the venue was relatively small, their sincerity…

This place was all decked out for BTS’s FESTA, and as an ARMY I was having the time of my life! The one thing that I want to note is that It was a little bit disorganized because I did not know where to go when I arrived like, where do I check in because I had already booked on Klook so I think they can improve on that part. But other than that, the experience was really nice. I would totally recommend anyone to do…
It’s best experienced at night 🥰 The atmosphere becomes even more beautiful and lively, making it the perfect time to take it all in.

rv.t: Absolutely loved Huinnyeoul Cultural Village. Compared to other popular tourist spots, it felt noticeably less crowded, which made the whole experience more relaxing and enjoyable. Getting there and back was also very convenient using Uber, and the trip was smooth both ways. The village itself has a charming, laid-back atmosphere, with narrow alleys, ocean views, and a creative, artsy vibe. One of my favorite parts…

I actually prefer this over gamcheon but they are indeed gorg on their own. I visit this place before during autum to early winter last 2024 and back this summer 2026. I still look forward to be back again here. This place is really scenic and relaxing. The different seasons also give different vibes. It is a must go back place for me.

Another colourful spot with beautifully designed buildings, but quite different from Gamcheon Culture Village. This one is located along the seaside, and you need to walk uphill as you explore the area. We visited on a day with 20+ degree weather, and walking along the seaside under the sun can get quite hot. However, I can imagine this place would be absolutely lovely in cooler weather perfect for a relaxed stroll…

GWに家族で訪れました❢|清潔感があり、トイレもお風呂も清潔感があり、快適でした。|お部屋も清潔で広く窓から水芭蕉が見え、どこを覗いても風景が素敵でした。||夕食も朝食も本当に美味しく、食べ過ぎてしまうほど。感じよく親切な接客でとても良い休日を過ごせました。||
ご飯がとても美味しいお宿です。奥社から歩いて行ける距離にあるので5社巡りの際に宿泊させていただきました。 早朝に植物園の散歩もできて気持ちよかったです。 トイレやお風呂は共有ですが常に清潔でした。 長く続けていただきたいです。

rv.t: Lake Nojiri offers crystal-clear waters perfect for boating and fishing. In summer, you can enjoy the cool breezes and scenic hiking trails, while winter transforms the area into a snowy wonderland ideal for skiing. The tranquil atmosphere, combined with the stunning natural landscape, makes Lake Nojiri a captivating destination for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts.

How does it feels to have a boat ride surrounded by mountains ? Yesterday my family went sightseeing at lake Nojiri and we took a speed boat round the lake where we had a good scenic view of the mountains and the small island in the middle of the lake. It was a Low season and we can easily go around the lake without much traffic. Occasionally you will see some people fishing at the lake, I supposed is a great place…

Lovely lake, very cooling and breezy despite the summer heat. Got to spend few nights here, did the 15km run around the lake which was epic. Just dont forget to spray bug spray, cause omg I had to run faster to run away from them

Suggest to inform visitors about the Sora Terrace visibility conditions at the ticket counter and let visitors to decide whether proceeding the trip or not. It was relatively expensive ticket price at Yen5000 per person to ride up to the terrace. We paid Yen10000 for two just to go up to have instant noodles and ice cream at the cafe. The cable car was…

This place is cool 🤩 From base to apex was an adventure! Buy your ticket, load up into the van with the plan to go anywhere and get chauffeured to the gondola base station. 10 steps later you are on the gondola and gawking at the most fabulous view while you gain gratuitous vertical feet. At the summit you are greeted by a short shuffle in the snow to Sora Terrace where you a warm and can enjoy a feed before you get…

Quite an adventure. We didn’t plan to ski. So we took a snow buggy to the base station and then the ropeway. Ropeway runs every 20 minutes. The restaurant on the top is quite good although we just had a coffee and cocoa. Its a good experience. Better to pre purchase tickets during peak season if that option is available.

The flavors were authentic, the portions were generous, and everything tasted fresh. On top of that, the service was warm, friendly, and attentive, making the dining…

It’s conveniently located just an 8-minute walk from Shibuya Crossing. I ordered the onion dosa and chicken tandoori, and both were absolutely delicious. A special shout-out to the host/manager, who was exceptionally friendly and made us feel welcome despite the rush. A great choice for…

1641.aj: 〒216-0011 神奈川県川崎市宮前区犬蔵１丁目９−２１ コーポ向井８３ 101 ​フカダパスタ

rv.t: ディナーで予約して伺いました。 前菜の盛り合わせが種類も豊富、ボリュームもあってとっても美味しい！ワインがすすむ！ パスタも美味しかったですが、とにかく前菜がおすすめです。 お値段はなかなか高め。ウーロン茶640円？くらいしていてびっくりしました。 前菜、メインのお肉、パスタ、ビール、グラスワインを注文して2人で1.5万くらいでした。 普段使いは出来ないけど、記念日などにまた行きたいです。

ずっと行きたくて行けてなかったパスタ屋さんでした。 平日のお昼12時になる少し前に到着しましたが、すぐに席に座れました！しかし、12時を過ぎると続々と店内にお客さんが来てあっという間に満席に！！ 席はカウンター席×ハイチェアのみのこじんまりした店内なので小さな子連れの方(ベビーカー等)は難しいかもしれません。 1順目は当日の10時頃までに公式サイトにて予約が出きるようです！ 注文をするとすぐにフレッシュなサラダと温かい野菜とベーコンのスープが運ばれてきました。これがまたどちらも美味しくて、、、 また、食べ終ったらすぐに頼んだパスタが運ばれてきました！今回頼んだパスタはフレッシュトマトとモッツァレラのパスタです。とても香りよく熱々で全体的にバランスがとれており、かつ絶品なパスタでした！こんなに美味しいパスタは久しぶりに食べました！ その後、生苺ミルキーのかき氷を頼んでいたのですが、こちらもすぐに運ばれてきました！…
2024秋になり、夏場から価格があがった模様。かなり凝ったパスアなので、素材等にもかなり配慮を感じられる。美味しいので、価格アップは仕方がないと思う。以前、パスタに付いていた小サラダとスープが有料になってたのが値上がり分。パスタ自体の金額については据え置きでした。いつも11時の優先予約で伺っているが、1巡目が終わると順番待ちのお客さんが結構いらっしゃっていた。

1642.a: Senjōjiki Cirque, １ Akaho, Komagane, Nagano 399-4117, Japan
1642.aj: 〒399-4117 長野県駒ヶ根市赤穂１ 千畳敷カール
1642.ed: Glacial landform with jagged edges & wildflowers, reached by cable car & popular for mountaineering.
1642.edj: 野の花の咲く、縁がギザギザになった氷河地形。ロープウェイでアクセス可能。登山で人気。

rv.t: The thrilling cable ride to the hotel offers a breathtaking view is the surrounding. Got to see a mountain-top sunrise over the Southern alps and a distance view of Mt Fuji. Definite worth the experience.
We visited on the last week of April 2025, but the area was still full of snow! You will need a proper chain spike if you want to climb to the peak and move on to other peaks. Beautiful scenery.

Beautiful sight at the summit with with a view of the alps mountains peak and surrounding mountains! Get a bus ticket every 30min and ride a 7 min ride the cable car to the top. The hike can be friendly, but you still need good shoes because it’s a path made of rocks.

1643.a: THE UPPER, 丸の内テラス 10F 1 Chome-3-4 Marunouchi, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 100-0005, Japan
1643.aj: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内１丁目３−４ 丸の内テラス 10F THE UPPER
1643.ed: People say this restaurant offers delicious and beautifully presented dishes, with popular choices including the duck confit and the Tokyo Mont Blanc dessert. They also highlight the sophisticated, open atmosphere and the attentive staff. Some reviews mention the food offerings can be inconsistent.
1643.edj: クチコミでは、このレストランは美味しくて見た目も美しい料理を提供していると評判です。特に、鴨のコンフィや東京モンブランというデザートが人気を集めているようです。また、洗練された開放的な雰囲気と、気の利くスタッフも高く評価されています。 一方で、料理の提供が安定しないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: The Upper is recommended by Michelin and it deserves at least 2 stars. The atmosphere on top of the building was very tranquil, music was set at the perfect level that you could hear it but still have a conversation with those across the table without staining. Then the flavor of all the foods we tried was nothing less than awesome!!! I magnificent experience that I highly recommend.

I visited for a birthday dinner and had reserved a private room in advance since we were a group and wanted to avoid disturbing other guests if we became loud. The food was excellent, and the atmosphere of the restaurant was very nice. Most of the staff were polite and professional. However, unfortunately, one staff member who served our table gave us a very disappointing experience. He was not attentive, often did…

I came here for my birthday week dining out at different restaurants for the week. I really wanted to like this restaurant, it looks great and the menu sounded delicious. They did a great job with the interior, very French and New York. But as soon as we were sat, we were tended by this unfriendly waitress. She was rushing and seemed very impolite. Throughout the whole service, she just didn’t have patience and…

1644.aj: 〒399-4115 長野県駒ヶ根市上穂栄町３−１１ FIRST MOUNTAIN

rv.t: Awesome shop with a wonderful curation! Workers are amazing and a great mission. Definitely a place to visit and shop!
品揃えはいいけど、店員さんの態度が無愛想でした。 私も古着屋初心者で勝手がわからなかったてのもありますが、入店時の挨拶も無ければ案内も無く始めて放たれた言葉が少しキレ気味な感じ？で試着の際は声掛けてもらってもいいっすか？でした。 商品自体は欲しかった物なので買いましたが、入り辛いお店認定になりました。
コーヒーの応募で当選させていただきお伺いさせていただきました。初め何屋さんか分からず、コーヒー屋さんのイメージで行きましたが、ビンテージ屋さんが中心でしょうか？奥に喫茶のスペースがありました。親切な店員さんで丁寧にコーヒーを淹れていただきました。コクがありスッキリ苦味の美味しいコーヒーでした。シフォンケーキもあり今度頂こうと思います。

1645.a: Japan, 〒399-9301 Nagano, Kitaazumi District, Hakuba, リゾートホテル ラ・フォーレ白馬 La Foret Hakuba 大字北城落倉14913
1645.aj: 〒399-9301 長野県北安曇郡白馬村リゾートホテル ラ・フォーレ白馬 La Foret Hakuba 大字北城落倉14913
1645.ed: Relaxed hot spring hotel in a half-timbered mansion with a restaurant, a cafe & hot spring baths.
1645.edj: 木骨造りの邸宅風のくつろげる温泉ホテル。レストラン、カフェ、温泉浴場を併設。

rv.t: My girlfriend and I stayed at La Foret Hakuba last month while skiing Hakuba Valley. The staff is very friendly! Some of them do not speak english but we didn't have much of a problem communicating through google translate. The hotel itself isn't very close to the nightlife or the main bus system but the hotel has it's own bus and bus schedule. You can walk to tsugaike to get on the main bus line (I wouldn't…

Enjoyed staying here for a weekend while snowboarding. Service was great, food was good, free shuttle service to resorts, nice public hot baths, and rooms were spacious enough. Room had a small refrigerator and water boiler for tea. TV was outdated but we didn't use it since the channels were all in Japanese. The free wifi was great enough to stream videos.
nice snow activity

1646.a: Beni Tokage, スタディ・イン新町 １階 2 Chome-4-15 Shinmachi, Setagaya City, Tokyo 154-0014, Japan
1646.aj: 〒154-0014 東京都世田谷区新町２丁目４−１５ スタディ・イン新町 １階 餃子荘紅蜥蜴 桜新町店
1646.ed: Diners like this restaurant's rich and creamy tantanmen, which features a perfect balance of sesame flavor and spicy, numbing accents, as well as their juicy gyoza and flavorful fried rice. They also highlight the quick service, clean interior, and the convenience of paying with cash only. Some reviews mention payment can be cash-only.
1646.edj: この中華料理店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、濃厚でクリーミーな担々麺が高く評価されています。ごまの風味と、痺れるような辛さのバランスが絶妙なようです。ジューシーな餃子や風味豊かなチャーハンもおすすめとして挙げられています。 また、料理の提供が早く、店内は清潔感があり、現金でしか支払いができないという情報があります。

rv.t: I really enjoyed the food here. It’s a small place, with limited seating, but big on taste. The fried rice was good, and the pork belly was absolutely delicious. I also had the gyoza which were very different than traditional ones, but nonetheless enjoyable. The staff was friendly and the service fast. Check this place out if you get the chance.
A unique tiny Chinese food restaurant still maintaining a few decades old atmosphere. If you love Tantamen try it here. Also don't forget "yaki gyoza"
the tantan noodles here are hard to beat. Not too spicy, with lots of sesame. Not to mention it arrives in 5minutes.

1647.a: Warito, Cross One, 3 Chome-7-10 Aobadai, 目黒区 Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0042, Japan
1647.aj: 〒153-0042 東京都目黒区青葉台３丁目７−１０ クロスワン 和利道
1647.ed: Diners like this ramen shop's rich, flavorful tonkotsu gyokai tsukemen with thick, chewy noodles, and appreciate that large portions are available at no extra cost. They also highlight the spotless interior and efficient one-person operation. Other reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
1647.edj: このラーメン店を訪れたユーザーは、濃厚で風味豊かな豚骨魚介つけ麺と、太くてコシのある麺を高く評価しています。また、大盛りを無料で提供している点も好評です。店内は清潔で、店主が一人で効率的に営業していることにも注目が集まっています。 一方で、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Small counter ramen restaurant, dominated by the kitchen behind, where the delicious ramen is made. The menu is simple and honest but some of the best ramen we have had. Order from the vending machine (as of April 2018 the top row is cold noodles, the bottom is hot). The serves sizes are tempered by how much noodle you want to eat - they ask, all sizes the same price). The owner (we presume) speaks more than enough…

This is on a few top 10 lists for Tokyo tsukemen, and I think that's correct. It's so yummy. Order by machine. Counter seating. Gets busy between 12-1330. You can order your noodles 🍜 cold 🥶 or hot 🥵. They also let you choose your noodle size. Some people order a hot stone 🔥🪨 to reheat the broth. Pretty cool sight to see. I saw a few people complain it's not as good as some other fancy Michelin star places... But…

Rich and flavourful niboshi/gyokai (and possibly tonkotsu) based dipping broth. Fresh tasty noodles, you can choose portion size (all same price) and heated (in a bowl of hot water) noodles or cold/room temp noodles when you hand in your ticket. Table toppings include dried fried onions, vinegar, ichimi chili flakes, and black pepper. If you want to reheat your dip, you can request a "yakishi" (baked rock) to put…

1648.a: Delizioso Firenze, Shin-Marunouchi Building, 5F 1 Chome-5-1 Marunouchi, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 100-6505, Japan
1648.aj: 〒100-6505 東京都千代田区丸の内１丁目５−１ 新丸の内ビル 5F DELIZIOSO FIRENZE
catj: モダン居酒屋レストラン
トスカーナ料理店（イタリア）
1648.ed: Diners like this Italian restaurant's delicious and authentic dishes, including fresh carpaccio, flavorful pasta, and hearty pizzas, with generous portions. They also highlight the attentive service, pleasant atmosphere, and excellent value, especially for lunch courses. Other reviews mention the staff can be unprofessional.
1648.edj: 好きな料理をメニューから選ぶプリフィックスコースで本格イタリアンが楽しめる。ワインの種類も豊富に取り揃えている。

rv.t: Aug 27, 2025 Decent and reliable spot. Tomato-based Italian ham pasta and cheese gnocchi were both quite good. Same for Italian creme brulee and hot latte for dessert. No wait at 19:15 with no reservation on a Wednesday.
This Italian restaurant is relatively less crowded than others in the area. The pizza here was really delicious! They have good options for wine.

Lunch on a weekday here was great. There was a choice of Set A for ¥1,980 or Special Set for ¥2,980. The only dofference was the latter comes with a main dish of fish/meat. The lunch set comes with a very generous serving of appetizer, pasta or pizza, dessert and drink. Interestingly enough, even the lunch choices for drink included sparkling wine and beer. I had the signature lasagne which had the fragrance of…

1649.a: Japan, 〒966-0501 Fukushima, Yama District, Kitashiobara, Hibara, 五色沼
1649.aj: 〒966-0501 福島県耶麻郡北塩原村檜原 五色沼

rv.t: It was a famous scenic place compared to 九寨溝 in 四川 China. Much smaller scale and less spectacular backdrop of course but very well maintained and clean . You can start at either end and track for 2.4 km for 1.4 hours and then take bus back . The bus stops are however tricky to locate and bus are infrequent so beware don’t get stranded

Most people go there in the autumn to see red leaves, but i think it is beatiful during the summer as well. The transportation was confusing to us. We should have got off the bus at a stop called 入り口 or something, but we followed google map and got off somewhere further, so we had to walked back for 30 minutes. There were some options for lunch. They do have restaurants, and small vendors selling ice cream, takoyaki…
We got here when the peak of the fall foliage has gone for a week. Only managed to take few pictures on the remaining maple trees with rowing boats on the background.

1650.a: Japan, 〒321-1662 Tochigi, Nikko, Yumoto, 五色沼
1650.aj: 〒321-1662 栃木県日光市湯元 五色沼

rv.a: びっぐぱりももじろう
rv.t: 菅沼から登りました。 とにかく素晴らしい所です、是非訪れて下さい五色沼を眺めながらのカップ麺と缶ビール最高！
上から見おろすよりも、水際まで行くことがいかに大変かと言うことがわかりました。大変貴重な沼です。
名前の由来かグラデーションかかった色が美しい池です。周辺は砂浜になっていて、登山の休憩に最適です。 周辺は花畑になっており、特に白根山の東側斜面の花畑から見る五色沼の美しさは格別です。

1651.a: Yeongcheon Yeonghwa, 3 Dosan-daero 90-gil, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
1651.aj: ヨンチョンヨンファ ３ Dosan-daero 90-gil, Gangnam District, Seoul, 韓国

rv.t: Booked ahead and got a cozy private room for dinner. The Korean beef tartare was a standout—perfectly marinated and easily one of the best I’ve had. Our server was incredibly kind, efficient, and recommended two BBQ cuts that were tender, juicy, and grilled to perfection right at the table. The banchan (side dishes) were plentiful and packed with flavor. The walls are covered with celebrity signatures, which adds to…

Selling rib fingers as beef ribs feels deceptive. I visited this restaurant after hearing positive feedback and decided to have a late dinner, ordering one portion of beef rib. When the server brought out the dish, she explained that an order of 갈비살 (beef rib) consists of three pieces of rib fingers and three pieces of beef rib. I pointed out that rib fingers are significantly cheaper than beef ribs, making it clear…

The yukhoe tasted great. A great umami/sweet flavour with sesame oil. The portion was a bit small though for the price. I believe I paid 21,000 Won for the yukhoe. I would actually go back again. Got there around 12:30 and was seated pretty much straight away without much of a wait. The side dishes were mostly great. Wasn't the biggest fan of the cabbage kimchi and the brown jelly like thing. The lady at the tills…

1652.a: Nishibama Beach, Aka, Zamami, Shimajiri District, Okinawa 901-3311, Japan
1652.aj: 〒901-3311 沖縄県島尻郡座間味村阿嘉 北浜ビーチ

rv.t: I recommend going in the morning. There’s less people. When the ferry docks, loads of people are walking towards here.
Peaceful beach with an amazing view. Clear beautiful water, close to aka port. I was able to see sea turtles from the look out point above the beach.
🌴 just beautiful quiet beach ideal for snorkeling 🤿

1653.a: Zamami Island, Zamami, Shimajiri District, Okinawa, Japan
1653.aj: 沖縄県島尻郡座間味村 座間味島
1653.ed: Tranquil island with scenic white-sand beaches & clear aqua water for scuba diving & snorkeling.
1653.edj: のどかな島。美しい白い砂浜と、スキューバ ダイビングやシュノーケリングができる透き通った海がある。

rv.t: If you are visiting Okinawa, don't leave without visiting Zamami Island. The beaches are a beauty and one of the best places for a solo traveller to visit.

If you ever enter to know what the zombie apocalypse might be like then this is the place to come. The main town is shabby with tired looking buildings and weeds everywhere. The locals are miserable and unfriendly. We did not feel welcome here. Good luck trying to find somewhere to eat as most restaurants and cafes are closed with no set opening times. Don't even think about using Google to check if restaurants are…

The greatest snorkeling experience u can have! Ocean are very well preserved, full of coral reels and sea turtle! We stayed in kerama blue resort for 2 days. U can rent a scooter to mover around the island. There are so many different beautiful beaches. Also can do some hiking!

1654.a: Japan, 〒863-2801 Kumamoto, Amakusa, Amakusamachi Oe, 4159 天草のラピュタ
1654.aj: 〒863-2801 熊本県天草市天草町大江４１５９ 天草のラピュタ
1654.ed: Visitors say this park features a mystical Akou tree, often called "Amakusa's Laputa," with thick trunks and numerous aerial roots embracing a giant rock. They also highlight the surrounding natural beauty, including many cherry blossom trees, creating a fantastic atmosphere. Guests mention the ample parking and a nearby observation deck.
1654.edj: この公園を訪れた人は、神秘的なアコウの木を高く評価しています。この木は「天草のラピュタ」とも呼ばれ、太い幹と無数の気根が巨大な岩を包み込むように広がっているのが特徴です。また、多くの桜の木を含む周囲の豊かな自然も魅力で、幻想的な雰囲気を醸し出しているというクチコミが多くあります。駐車場は広く、近くには展望台もあるという情報もあります。

rv.t: 駐車場にはトイレと自販機あり。階段を下りラピュタの木登場✨根っこで大きな石をしっかりつかまえ、素敵でした✨もっと下って行くと海を見渡せる展望所があります。これも大きな石の上！自然って素晴らしい✨
ジブリ好きには たまらない場所 公園から 数分階段を下る 途中にある あこう木で 岩に絡まり その名の通り ラピュタみたい❗ 思わず 「バルス」って 言いたくなります (笑) 更に150メートル下ると 展望台もあります 公園は、桜の木が沢山で 花見にも良いです 駐車場は、広くて数ヶ所あります

一人旅にて、居酒屋の大将に教えてもらった、特別な場所！ 細い道を通っていくと、公園が見えてきます👀 奥には下へ降りる階段があり、そこを下っていくとラピュタの最後のシーンを思わせる光景が… 呪文を唱えた後、飛行石が木に埋まったままラピュタごと空へ飛んでいくシーン🚀 …分かりますかね？(笑) とりあえず、大きな石を木の根が覆うように広がっている光景は、どこか神秘的でもあります✨️ 景色もよく海を見ていると、心を浄化してくれます🌸 皆さんも心の癒しに、ひと目見に行かれてはどうでしょうか？

1655.a: Itaru, 2 Chome-7-5 Katamachi, Kanazawa, Ishikawa 920-0981, Japan
1655.aj: 〒920-0981 石川県金沢市片町２丁目７−５ のど黒めし本舗 いたる
1655.ed: Compact neighborhood restaurant with an easygoing ambiance serving traditional fish dishes.
1655.edj: こぢんまりとした、街中の居酒屋。ゆったりとした雰囲気の中で伝統的な魚料理を味わえる。

rv.t: Come here at 11.45, the restaurant is full, so need to wait around 1 hour which is quiet long. To be honest the customer turnover process is very slow. I can see lots of customer has paid around 12.15-12.30, but we still need to wait for a while until we got seated (same with 2 persons before us) The dish: there are 2 main dishes during lunch, nodogoro (white grilled fish) and gomaburi, which is a sashimi donburi…

Food was amazing, very comforting. The nodoguro is fresh and aromatic, the rice is flavorful, and the broth is delicious. The barley tea is very refreshing as well, and the pickles are perfectly sour. Ordering is easy, and the service is great. My server was very friendly, and the chef lady was super sweet. Came back again the next day. Highly recommend a stop!

Shockingly bad. Frozen Nodoguro, so don’t worry about what time of year you come. Rice was flavorless and the dashi was flat. Complete tourist trap. To charge ¥4,400 for it is ridiculous. A fresh fish donburi at the fish market is much more satisfying. Such a poor representation of such a delicious fish. Thank God there was no wait at 2:30pm, otherwise I would have been even more upset.

1655.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1656.aj: 〒562-8508 大阪府箕面市粟生間谷２９１４−１ 応頂山 勝尾寺
1656.ed: Centuries-old Buddhist temple & gardens known for fall colors & thousands of red Daruma dolls.
1656.edj: 数世紀の歴史を持つ寺院と庭園。秋の紅葉と数千の赤いダルマで名高い。

rv.t: Katsuo-ji Temple is easily one of the most magical and memorable temples we have visited in Japan. From the moment you arrive, you begin spotting little daruma dolls everywhere. On the steps, along the pathways, beside the ponds, and even hidden quietly among the trees. Every corner seems to reveal another surprise. Each daruma represents a wish, a goal, or a new beginning, and seeing thousands of them scattered…

Katsuo-ji Temple is definitely worth the trip, even though it’s located a bit outside the city. Getting there is straightforward thanks to the frequent and well-organized bus service from the station. The bus fare is 800 yen for adults and 400 yen for children, and you’ll need an IC card to pay. Although it’s a popular and somewhat touristy spot, you’ll also see plenty of locals visiting, which gives it a more…

5/5 Stars – Katsuo-ji Temple: The Ultimate "Lucky Daruma" Spot Near Osaka! A Total Highlight Katsuo-ji Temple (勝尾寺, also known as Katsuoji or the Temple of Victory) is hands-down one of the most unique and memorable temples I've visited in Japan—definitely a must-see if you're in the Osaka area, especially as a fun side trip from Minoh Park or the waterfall. Nestled in the forested hills of Minoh City (about 30-45…

1657.a: Namba Yasaka Jinja, 2 Chome-9-19 Motomachi, Naniwa Ward, Osaka, 556-0016, Japan
1657.aj: 〒556-0016 大阪府大阪市浪速区元町２丁目９−１９ 難波八阪神社
1657.ed: Small shrine featuring a ritualistic performance stage in the shape of a lion's head.
1657.edj: 獅子頭の形をした舞台で知られる小さな神社。

rv.t: It was an interesting shrine to visit. The shrine itself is beautiful, well maintained, and has a peaceful atmosphere despite the crowds. The only downside was how busy it was. There were so many people that it felt more like a tourist attraction than a place of worship. That being said, I would still recommend visiting, especially if it’s your first time in the area. If possible, try to come early in the morning…

At Namba Yasaka Shrine, visitors can admire the famous giant lion-head stage, take unique photos, pray for good fortune, write wishes on traditional wooden ema plaques, purchase lucky charms, and enjoy a peaceful break from the busy streets of Osaka. It's a great spot to experience Japanese culture, appreciate the shrine's architecture, and learn about Shinto traditions. Best time to go is early morning or late…

A relatively small temple complex in Namba, but an absolute must-see if you're in the area. The main attraction is obviously the massive lion-head-shaped building: impressive and imposing, yet fitting naturally into the space without feeling overly tacky. I already knew about it before visiting, but I can only imagine the pleasant surprise of just strolling through this quiet, standard residential neighborhood and…

1658.a: Japan, 〒563-0132 Osaka, Toyono District, Nose, Nomanaka, 215-1 野間の森 MIGIWA
1658.aj: 〒563-0132 大阪府豊能郡能勢町野間中２１５−１ 野間の森 MIGIWA
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: Suddenly found it on Google Maps -hard to get to and a bit pricey, but definitely worth it! Follow the signs through the rice fields, to the repurposed house in its own grove of trees. Natural and rustic. We were lucky to get in without a reservation. The service was great, and the food fantastic. We loved the juicy Tonkatsu sandwich with pineapple sauce and the crepe dessert. The Migiwa salad fresh with veggies…

本日、旦那と母を連れてランチで訪れました。 前菜は繊細な味で、キャベツのスープもコーンやジャガイモとは違った美味しさがありました。 私は鮮魚のポアレを頂いたのですが、表面がカリッと中はふんわりの焼き方で、味も抜群でした。 デザートは米粉のケーキでソースの味も美味しすぎて、ケーキにたっぷりつけて食べました。 隠れ家的なわかりにくい場所にはありましたが、素敵なお店だったので私的には超オススメです。 お店の方も感じが良かったので、花丸です！
訪れた時はまだ紫陽花が残っていました。庭には桜や紅葉もあったようですのでそれぞれの季節にも行ってみたいです。 単品もありましたが、ランチのコースは４つありました。折角なのでランチコースを頂きましたが、料金の分の価値はあったかと思います。 店員さんも色んな個性の女性がいらっしゃいましたが、皆さん共通して接客と笑顔が素敵でした。 ぜひオススメします。

1658.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1659.a: Hirakata Park, 1-1 Hirakatakoencho, Hirakata, Osaka 573-0054, Japan
1659.aj: 〒573-0054 大阪府枚方市枚方公園町１−１ ひらかたパーク
1659.ed: Sprawling theme park featuring thrill rides such as roller coasters, plus eateries & seasonal pools.
1659.edj: ジェット コースターなど、スリル満点の乗り物がある巨大テーマパーク。飲食店や季節限定のプールもある。

rv.t: We arrived at the park around 12:00 PM and paid approximately 5,500 yen per person for admission with unlimited rides. Unfortunately, despite this price, we were barely able to enjoy the attractions. The main issue is extremely poor organization. The minimum waiting time for major rides was around 2 hours each. As a result, the “unlimited rides” ticket was practically meaningless. To be able to ride even once, we…

We skipped USJ and chose to visit this park instead, and it was a fantastic decision. We went as a family of four (two adults and two kids), and the park was spacious, beautifully decorated, and very kid-friendly. There were plenty of rides suitable for young children, lots of food options, and wide open spaces for the kids to run around. We spent the entire day there and still didn’t feel rushed. Most rides had…

The oldest amusement park in Japan. We stayed here the entire day to explore the rides and attractions. Plenty of food options for small and bigger kids. Queue for rides and attraction can go up to 1hr ++. For the price, I think it’s worth. This place is huge!

1659.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

1660.a: Shinsaibashi Station, 3-chōme-12 Minamisenba, Chuo Ward, Osaka, 542-0081, Japan
1660.aj: 〒542-0081 大阪府大阪市中央区南船場３丁目１２ 心斎橋駅
1660.ed: Visitors say this station is clean, convenient, and well-maintained, with direct connections to major shopping areas like Shinsaibashi-suji and Crysta Nagahori. They also highlight its excellent access to other key Osaka areas via the Midosuji and Nagahori Tsurumi-ryokuchi lines. Some reviews mention wheelchair accessibility can be difficult.
1660.edj: クチコミによると、この駅は清潔で便利、そして手入れが行き届いていると評価されています。心斎橋筋商店街やクリスタ長堀のような主要なショッピングエリアに直結しており、御堂筋線や長堀鶴見緑地線を利用して、大阪の他の主要エリアへもアクセスしやすい点が特徴です。 一方で、車椅子での利用は難しい場合があるという声もあります。

rv.t: A spacious and clean train station. As a first-time visitor, I found it a little confusing to navigate. Although the ticket machines have an English option, I couldn't figure out how to buy a direct ticket to Universal Studios, so I ended up purchasing a ticket to Nishikujo first and then buying another one from there. I tried asking the staff for help, but communication was a bit difficult due to the language…

Another important station that connects Osaka to nearby Kyoto and other parts of the prefecture. It’s the less busier station compared to Namba. But if you’re going to dotonbori this is quite near and accessible. Japanese efficiency as always

Shinsaibashi Station is one of the most beautiful stations in the city. The name itself is a nod to the area's history; Shinsaibashi refers to the original Shinsai Bridge that once crossed the Nagahori canal. While the canal is long gone, the station keeps that sense of grandeur alive. The standout feature here is definitely the Midosuji Line platform. Most subway stations are pretty utilitarian, but this one feels…

1661.a: Yodobashi Umeda Tower mae, 1 Ōfukachō, Kita Ward, Osaka, 530-0011, Japan
1661.aj: 〒530-0011 大阪府大阪市北区大深町１ ヨドバシ梅田タワー前（バス）

rv.t: Yodobashi Umeda Tower mae is a convenient and stylish transportation hub in the heart of Osaka. With direct access to the Osaka Metro and JR lines, it's the perfect place to start your exploration of the city.

従業員の方が、バスが到着したら案内してくれます。 バスが到着順に乗り場が変わるので、出発時刻に余裕を持って到着した方が良いです。 リンクス梅田内ですが近くにファミリーマートがあります。 ファミリーマート内でバス情報も見れますが10分前にはバス停で待っていることをおすすめします。 またバス停付近に『トイレ』はないので、事前に行っておく必要があります。トイレに行きたいと言う人が、近くにないと言われてました。
はじめて行く方はヨドバシカメラの中にある、ファミマを目指したらいいと思います。 はじめて行って迷いました。 高速バスの待合所がありますが、広くはありません。待合室の椅子も限られております。 トイレがありませんのでお気をつけて下さい。 1番近いのはヨドバシカメラ地下の飲食街かと思われます。高速バスの時刻は夜のため。

1662.a: Kanazawa Castle Park, 1-1 Marunouchi, Kanazawa, Ishikawa 920-0937, Japan
1662.aj: 〒920-0937 石川県金沢市丸の内１−１ 金沢城公園
1662.ed: Reconstructed 16th-century castle famous for its extensive surrounding garden, with tours.
1662.edj: 16 世紀の城を復元した城郭。広大な公園が有名で、ツアーも開催。

rv.t: My girlfriend and I visited Kanazawa Castle Park and enjoyed it very much! The grounds are huge and beautifully kept, with a very good vibe. The white walls of the castle buildings are stunning, especially against the blue sky. It is a very peaceful and comfortable place to walk and learn about history. 10/10 experience!

Amazing park to get lost in or walk around. Getting there before 9/10am is key since after that the tour buses start to roll in. But fair warning if you come earlier the food/tea shops won’t be open yet. However you will have great opportunities to take photos without people in the background. Park is smaller than it seems so it is easy to walk the entirety of it. Pebbled walkways so stroller got stuck a bit but we…
Kanazawa Castle Park is truly a gem! 🏯 I absolutely loved exploring the beautiful grounds and historic architecture. This is a must-visit for anyone traveling to Ishikawa. Highly recommend! 🌳🌸✨

1663.a: Teuchisoba Shuhari Tanimachi, 安藤ビル 1F 1 Chome-3-20 Tokiwamachi, Chuo Ward, Osaka, 540-0028, Japan
1663.aj: 〒540-0028 大阪府大阪市中央区常盤町１丁目３−２０ 安藤ビル 1F 手打蕎麦 守破離 谷町店
1663.ed: Diners appreciate the restaurant's flavorful soba, particularly the fragrant and firm handmade variety, alongside the crispy tempura featuring good seasonal vegetables. The stylish and modern Japanese atmosphere is also a highlight. Some reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
1663.edj: 窓外に緑を望む店内で、自家製の石臼挽き蕎麦の他、四季折々の素材を使用した創作料理が味わえる。全国各地から取り寄せた地酒を多数提供。

rv.t: "Remember me... when you see the new moon." -- Princess Kaguya My colleague and friend, Midori-san, wanted to meet for lunch on my day off. She asked what I was in the mood for and I chose Soba. She suggested Teuchisoba Shuhari 手打蕎麦 守破離, a highly popular, Michelin-recommended handmade Soba restaurant in Chuo-ku, Osaka. This was actually her second choice after we discovered her first choice was closed. As we…

Dinner at Teuchisoba Shuhari Tanimachi famous soba shop nearby to the Osaka castle. as it is a waited close to 1/2 hour. We ordered: - [ ] Ten Kake Soba - Hot soba soup topped with seafood and vegetable fritters - [ ] Aburi Torinan Soba - Hot soba soup of roasted chicken meat and leek - [ ] Shochu Ginnomizu kuro (barley) - [ ] Lemon sour

We were there in Oct of 2023 and had a great meal. We’re planning on coming back this year and will definitely eat there again when we go to Osaka Castle. We loved the soba, tempura, and the ambience of the place. Can’t wait to eat there again!

1663.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1664.aj: 〒920-0936 石川県金沢市兼六町１ 兼六園
1664.ed: One of only 3 'perfect gardens' in Japan, this park is designed to be beautiful during every season.
1664.edj: 日本三名園の一つ。どの季節でも美しく見えるように設計された庭園。

rv.t: DO NOT SKIP THIS on your trip through Japan. Most beautiful garden I saw in all of my trip. If you study about Japanese gardens you will enjoy it much more but even without understanding what you are looking at, it's impossible to feel wonder and amusement for such meticulous human labour to keep this garden so pristine and perfect; every single corner is perfectly balanced between nature and human work. Consider…

Kenroku-en is widely regarded as one of Japan’s three most beautiful landscape gardens, and after visiting, it is easy to understand why. The garden is exceptionally well maintained, with scenic ponds, traditional tea houses, stone lanterns, winding paths, and carefully designed landscapes that look beautiful in every season. What impressed me most was the peaceful atmosphere and the incredible attention to detail…

This is one of the best gardens we visited in Japan so far. Great layout and the trees are stunning all throughout. Amazing all the ground is covered in moss. There are some buildings, tea houses to visit throughout. Well worth coming here.

1665.a: Higashi Chaya District, 1 Chome-13 Higashiyama, Kanazawa, Ishikawa 920-0831, Japan
1665.aj: 〒920-0831 石川県金沢市東山１丁目１３ ひがし茶屋街
1665.ed: Traditional neighborhood with teahouses where geisha perform, plus shops selling gold-leaf crafts.
1665.edj: 昔の風情を守り、茶屋が立ち並ぶ街。お座敷での芸妓遊びのほか、金箔工芸の販売も。

rv.t: Walking through Higashi Chaya feels like stepping back in time. The preserved wooden 'kimagi' lattices are stunning, especially during the 'golden hour' just before sunset when the lanterns start to glow. ​It can get quite crowded in the main street, so my best advice is to wander into the smaller side alleys—that’s where you really feel the quiet, historical atmosphere. I highly recommend stopping for some matcha…

On the surface, this district of preserved traditional machiya timber houses is like a film set. You may as a visitor of Japan dismiss it because surely by now you would have or about to see plenty of similar cute looking and photogenic traditional Japanese houses. You may be right but what makes this one different is the hill that lays behind. It is full of shrines to visit. If I remember correctly there are thirty…

The Higashi Chaya District is a beautiful and atmospheric place to explore. The preserved wooden teahouses and narrow streets really transport you back in time, and it’s easy to imagine what the area must have been like during the Edo period. It’s especially lovely in the late afternoon when the light hits the buildings and everything feels warm and nostalgic. There are plenty of small shops and cafés to browse, and…

1666.a: Dormy Inn Kanazawa, 2-25 Horikawashinmachi, Kanazawa, Ishikawa 920-0849, Japan
1666.aj: 〒920-0849 石川県金沢市堀川新町２−２５ ドーミーイン金沢
1666.ed: Modest rooms in an unfussy lodging offering a restaurant, plus a communal bathhouse.
1666.edj: シンプルな客室の落ち着いたホテル。レストランと大浴場がある。

rv.t: This is a hard review for me. Because the staff is so nice and rhetorical Onsen is very decent and what I expected for a hotel at this price point. From a person that spends 200+ days a year in hotels I want to be realistic about my review. The location is great. The service is great. I knew the room was going to be small, but the linens and the bedding and the pillows were absolutely low budget garbage that needed…

Loved this hotel. Very convenient for the station. A lot of buses go from the station to different parts of the city. The breakfast was exceptional. Great range of Japanese food, prepared well. The room was a little small but it had all the amenities we needed and the shower was excellent.
The room is quite large for the size in Japan. Complete facilities with onsen and free ice cream. Also get udon every night. The location is also good, very close to Kanazawa station.

1667.a: Smile Hotel Premium Kanazawa Higashiguchi ekimae, 2-20 Horikawashinmachi, Kanazawa, Ishikawa 920-0849, Japan
1667.aj: 〒920-0849 石川県金沢市堀川新町２−２０ スマイルホテルプレミアム金沢東口駅前
1667.ed: People say this hotel offers clean, spacious, and comfortable rooms with modern furnishings and amenities like air purifiers. They also highlight its excellent value and convenient location, just a few minutes' walk from Kanazawa Station and a shopping mall. Guests mention the friendly and helpful staff, as well as the complimentary coffee and tea in the lobby.
1667.edj: このホテルを利用した人は、清潔で広々とした快適な客室を評価しています。客室にはモダンな家具が備え付けられており、空気清浄機などの設備も充実しているようです。また、金沢駅から徒歩数分、ショッピングモールもすぐ近くという便利な立地も高く評価されています。ロビーでは無料のコーヒーや紅茶が提供されており、スタッフの対応も親切で丁寧という声が多くあります。

rv.t: This is an excellent hotel. It is very close to the station, which is a huge advantage. Check-in was lightning fast, and the staff were very kind, helpful, and welcoming. The atmosphere of the hotel is very pleasant. The interior designer used bright, light colors, which makes the hotel feel comfortable, warm, and almost like home. The room size was completely suitable for two people with luggage, and the layout was…

Stayed at Smile Hotel Premium Kanazawa and had a great experience overall. The hotel offers excellent value for money, especially considering its convenient location—close to the train station and easy to get around the city. The staff were friendly and welcoming, making the stay even more pleasant. Check-in and check-out were both quick and hassle-free, which is always appreciated when traveling. A solid choice if…

We would like to enthusiastically commend the Smile Hotel Premium Kanazawa's front desk team for truly outstanding service even before we arrived! We ran into a flight cancellation by ANA, and were delayed one day in arriving. I called the hotel a few times to update the travel plan, and each time spoke with a manager with excellent English and cordial and supportive manners. Ms Fujita-san very capably and…

1668.a: Gamō Udon, 420-1 Kamocho, Sakaide, Kagawa 762-0023, Japan
1668.aj: 〒762-0023 香川県坂出市加茂町４２０−１ がもううどん
1668.ed: Popular hangout for traditional dishes from an open-air kiosk with outside seating.
1668.edj: 本格讃岐うどんの名店。屋外席を備えたうどん販売所スタイル。

rv.t: 1st stop on the Sanuki udon tour was Gamo Udon and honestly it set the tone immediately. This place felt incredibly authentic. Tiny old school shack style setup with a huge line outside and people eating at outdoor tables before returning their bowls themselves. Very simple. Very homie. The kind of place that feels untouched by trends. The udon itself was imperfect in the best way possible. Not overly polished or…

You get to see the boiling pot and the big net they use to transfer the udon while you’re in line to order. The space is a little tight but it’s a comfy homey vibe. The topping “age” was so big and sweet it’s a must try item!
So yummy! Very authentic udon, Definitely worth trying if you are in the area! Well priced and the place itself is very cute and has a nice atmosphere ☺️

1669.a: Hinode Seimenjyo, 1 Chome-8-5 Fujimicho, Sakaide, Kagawa 762-0046, Japan
1669.aj: 〒762-0046 香川県坂出市富士見町１丁目８−５ 日の出製麺所
1669.ed: Bustling noodle factory with a snug, down-to-earth eatery serving 4 types of udon for lunch.
1669.edj: 活気のある製麺所。ランチに 4 種類のうどんを食べられる落ち着いた雰囲気のくつろげる食堂を併設。

rv.t: 麵條很Q, 但要留意, 此店每天只營業1小時 (11:30-12:30), 不要遲到!! 那些女侍應非常友善~~!!! The Udon is very nice and the price are very reasonable. But please noticed that their opening hour just 11:30-12:30 (1 Hour) only.... please come and queue on time, Don't miss it~~~!!! The waitress very nice too!!!
Opening only one hour by 11:30, and limited for 100 bowls, tasted good with chewy texture, I more preferred the cold udon.

Kagawa is famous for udon, and here you can enjoy freshly made udon that is also popular among local people. Although there is a long waiting time, it is worth it, as the food is served quickly once you enter the shop and place your order. The shop is conveniently located within walking distance from Sakaide Station.

1669.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1670.a: Yamagoe Udon, 602-2 Hayukakami, 綾川町 Ayagawa, Ayauta District, Kagawa 761-2207, Japan
1670.aj: 〒761-2207 香川県綾歌郡綾川町羽床上６０２−２ 山越うどん
1670.ed: Popular, homely restaurant serving a variety of udon noodle dishes in a leafy outdoor space.
1670.edj: 緑に囲まれた屋外スペースで各種うどんを提供する人気のアットホームなレストラン。

rv.t: Nice and simple menu. What they serve is just Udon, hot or cold, tops with aburaage or egg or grated yam. The udon is extremely chewy and traditional. You can pick different tempura from the rank to accomplishing the udon. Price is acceptable and atmosphere is good. Be prepared to sit outdoors there is a garden like eating area. They also selling uncooked udon for you to bring home, parking lot for the shop is…

Very warm atmosphere. Makes you feel like your eating on grandmas porch 😊💕 Kamatamayama was so creamy and you get to enjoy the simple sweetness of the egg. Adding ginger paste and 7 peppers half way through changes the flavor and is a great experience🫧

Very popular udon shop for both locals and tourists. Relaxing garden atmosphere. Simplified menu with numbering 1 to 9 to choose from, for easy and efficient ordering. Good pricing for every option. Very friendly services. Recommended to begin with the standard size (一玉), and order second/different bowl if still craving for more. Can select either cold or warm udon.

1671.a: Ichiya Marugame-sanjo, 533-5 Sanjocho, Marugame, Kagawa 763-0094, Japan
1671.aj: 〒763-0094 香川県丸亀市三条町５３３−５ 一屋 丸亀三条店
1671.ed: Diners like this udon restaurant's delicious, thick noodles with a pleasant chewiness, and the flavorful broth. They also highlight the generous all-you-can-pile-on meat for a reasonable price, and the convenient, spacious parking. Other reviews mention the udon can be too soft.
1671.edj: このうどん店を利用したユーザーは、おいしい太麺と風味豊かな出汁を高く評価しています。麺は心地よい弾力があり、もちもちとした食感が特徴のようです。また、リーズナブルな価格で、肉を好きなだけ盛り付けられる点や、広くて便利な駐車場も好評です。 一方で、うどんが柔らかすぎると感じるクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Ok
Great old school udon restaurant, randomly found it 6 years ago and have been trying to get back there and finally got the chance and was just as tasty as before.
駐車場、座席数共に多めにあります。セルフのうどん屋です。中華そばを注文、少し柔らか目の中太麺で優しいかけ出汁によくあっていて美味しかったです。

1672.a: Trattoria La Grotta, プリンスビル B1F 5 Chome-10-1 Ginza, Chuo City, Tokyo 104-0061, Japan
1672.aj: 〒104-0061 東京都中央区銀座５丁目１０−１ プリンスビル B1F Trattoria La Grotta
1672.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and hearty Italian dishes, especially the flavorful pasta and generous portions of appetizers. They also highlight the reasonable prices for the quality and location, along with the welcoming atmosphere. Other reviews mention the service can be unprofessional.
1672.edj: このイタリアンレストランを利用した人は、美味しくてボリュームのある料理、特に風味豊かなパスタとたっぷりとした前菜を高く評価しています。また、この品質と立地で手頃な価格であることや、温かい雰囲気も好評のようです。 一方で、サービスがプロフェッショナルではないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: it was extremely busy when we arrived and we did not have a reservation. We were seated on a counter which is a very small dining space for plates and drinks and I hit my head on the hanging wine glasses, hence why my 6’3” boyfriend didn’t want to sit on that particular bar stool. but to be fair, i am 5’8” and the average japanese woman is 5’2”😅 considering we arrived at peak time without a reservation, beggars…

Tip: I recommend making a reservation before coming. 1st time I came here: I don’t know if it’s just because I was hungry or what, but that was some of the best food I’ve ever had. They fry their pizza which sounds a little strange at first, but believe me it’s good. The pasta was also good. Honestly the tomato sauce was so good I actually could probably drink it. The service was also so good it was very hard for me…

I have learned that basement restaurants have their own ambiance. This Italian grotto is cozy, friendly, & the food is wonderful. The seasonal menu included mozzarella di bufala & scallops from Hokkaido in a lemon sauce. Reservations a must. Very quaint & limited seating. Enjoy!!!!!

1672.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1673.a: Serval Wildlife, Engare Nairobi Road, Engare Nairobi, Tanzania
1673.aj: Serval Wildlife, Engare Nairobi Road, Engare Nairobi, タンザニア

rv.t: Our stay at Serval Wildlife was truly unforgettable, and a huge part of that was thanks to our incredible guide, Stephen. From the moment we arrived, he made us feel so welcome, always checking that we were comfortable, safe, and enjoying every moment. His knowledge of the animals was outstanding, and you could tell how passionate he is about their welfare. We stayed in the beautiful Cheetah Villa, which was…

If you're planning a trip to Tanzania, Serval Wildlife is an absolute must-visit. From the moment we arrived, we were blown away by the exceptional hospitality and unforgettable experience. I have nothing but praise for this incredible place. The staff are genuinely warm, welcoming, and attentive, making us feel at home from the very beginning. The rooms are spacious, beautifully designed, and offer the perfect…

Our stay at Serval Wildlife was simply incredible, truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Everything was perfect from start to finish. One of the things that makes this place so special is that you are assigned a dedicated guide who accompanies you throughout your entire stay and all activities, making the experience seamless, personal, and unforgettable. A very special thank you to our guide, Nashipai, who was…

1674.a: NUDE AMIGOS BROADBEACH, 2685 Gold Coast Hwy, Broadbeach QLD 4218, Australia
1674.aj: NUDE AMIGOS BROADBEACH, 2685 Gold Coast Hwy, Broadbeach QLD 4218 オーストラリア

rv.t: It’s okay! Good for Australian Mexican, service was average by our server. Didn’t clear our table and wasn’t attentive. Didn’t get any water. But halfway through our sitting two other servers started and they were much better. I’d say give it a go. The cocktail list is excellent.

Had our last dinner on holiday at Nude Amigos and it was perfect. Generous portions - the chicken fajitas were huge even for two people. The corn and the jalapeño balls were incredible. Simple children’s menu but our son was happy. Amazing margaritas - we had chilli, passionfruit and raspberry and they were all delicious. Highly recommend for a night out with friends or family.

It’s the first time for my lunch😋 It's a very nice decor in the restaurant🤩 I had a Michelada and an Achiote chicken Fajita with cheese😁 Michelada was quite nice🤩 It has saltiness, citrus and a bit spicy🥳 It's not a simple beer cocktail 🍹 I liked it🥳🥳🥳 I loved Fajita🤩🤩🤩 It looked so delicious when it was served 🥰 A sizzling sound was good too🥳 Wrapped with the sauces was soooo good. 1675.ed: Diners enjoy this cafe's authentic Vietnamese dishes, including rich coconut curry and mild pho, and appreciate the generous portions, good value, and spacious dining area. Other reviews mention the service can be slow and the food can lack authentic flavor.
1675.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、コクのあるココナッツカレーや優しい味わいのフォーなど、本格的なベトナム料理が高く評価されています。ボリュームもあってお得感があり、広々とした店内でゆったりと食事ができるという声が多くあります。 一方で、料理の提供や会計に時間がかかり、サービスが遅いという意見や、料理の味が本格的ではないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: This restaurant offers a clean, large, and spacious environment with polite, efficient, and friendly staff. I ordered a Vietnamese dish (JPY 1100), which featured a generous portion of pork, including two small meat patties. While the noodle portion was a bit light for my preference, it was ultimately sufficient. My dining companion enjoyed the pho, noting its perfectly balanced spicy kick. Unfortunately, the set…

This is my second time visiting, the staff is very friendly and the food is very delicious! The dishes looks slightly different than the menu but the taste is great! I personally recommend the butter scallops and the garlic beef pho, all the appetizers are great too.
Very authentic menu that you will not find at other vietnamese restaurants. The place is vey new and clean with great atmosphere. The chef is really nice and has some wonderful recommendations

1677.ed: Diners like this Thai restaurant's authentic dishes, including flavorful pad kra pao, green curry, and tom yum, with adjustable spice levels. They also highlight the convenient late lunch hours, movie ticket discounts, and pleasant terrace seating. Other reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
1677.edj: このタイ料理レストランを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、風味豊かなガパオライス、グリーンカレー、トムヤムクンなど、本格的な料理が高く評価されています。辛さの調整ができる点も好評です。また、遅めのランチ時間、映画のチケット割引、心地よいテラス席も特徴として挙げられています。 一方で、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないという意見もあります。

rv.t: The food is really flavorful, as you’d expect from authentic Thai cuisine. I especially liked the pad thai. You can really taste the fish sauce, dried shrimps and nuts. The noodle is al dente. I also liked the stir fried chicken with cashew nuts. The chicken was really flavorful. The cashew nuts added a little saltiness and sweetness to the dish. I wish it had a little more sauce though because it was really good…
If you love Thai food, GO for it! We were so happy and satisfied after the meal! I am sure you will be happy too! Authentic taste!

The worst pad thai I’ve ever had…no taste. It’s an insult to the thai cuisine! A horrible japanese version of pad thai with pickles ?!?!?! Real rating is 0 stars! But definitely 5 stars for the cook for the art of ruining pad thai!

rv.t: A Thai restaurant themed around street food. Rather than typical street food, it serves authentic Thai cuisine. The flavors are slightly bold, and the dishes are on the lighter side in terms of oil content. It offers a wide selection of Thai alcoholic beverages, making it the perfect spot for a drink.

Good Thai food. Plenty of options on the menu. Lots of seating inside also. Only minus points would be that cutlery wasn’t very clean and portion size was small. However still very tasty. If you want to see more photos and tips, feel free to check out my Instagram → @6yearsinjapan
I ordered tom yum kun and khao pad tom yum. I think the tom yum was too sour and fishy, but they gave me 3 prawn. The place was neat and clean.
